title: MSEP Area 2025 Data Summaries
text:
Introduction
This website is a collection of documents summarizing the condition of the Mississippi Sound and its watershed in 2025, as compared to “baseline” conditions (which we also need to define, at appropriate spatial scales for each parameter). The outputs are compiled as a ‘quarto book’. Each chapter is produced by a separate .qmd file.
The purpose of the book format is to make the outputs readily findable and accessible. It also serves as an outline for future undertakings like a complete baseline characterization of these parameters and future State of the Sound reports.
You can download a pdf version of this entire book by clicking on the pdf icon on the right side of the toolbar at the top of this page.

title: 10  Beach Advisories
text:
10.2 Supporting Information

10.2.1 DEQ Beach Sampling
Make a map where each station is represented by a point, and the point size is based on the number of days that station was under advisory in the year.
no. of beach closure days by station (see PPBEP’s online map)

Can download advisory/closure info from DEQ: https://beaches.mdeq.ms.gov/Historical/HCA
Per station, calculate # advisories/closures, # days under advisory/closure (total), mean or median # days per advisory/closure
Aggregate across coast: how many days under advisory/closure across all stations (sum of station totals); break down whether it’s just a few troublesome sites (seems to be based on presentations I’ve seen from DEQ) and what % of advisory/closure days came from those few sites
